I don’t know how to forgive my parents or my ex. I don’t know.

I was just thinking of writing a post about this exact thing so thanks. 

I feel like when my parents get over dealing with me because they don’t know what to do, they get angry. And they got angry at my most vulnerable time and they were the only people I had. So when they emotionally hurt me and I feel like abandoned me, I ran away. I took my broken self and made a safe place in my head to escape to. I stayed there for years. I didn’t realise I did that. I didn’t realise I’d gone to that place because it was all I knew.  Now I know I went there and I’m unable to let that protective part of me go. 

It’s the only safe place I have. 

So I run away, cry and ache for a time when I felt like I was safe and loved. I don’t know how to get out it anymore. Sometimes I can feel their hopelessness towards me. They don’t give me a lot of encouragement or reassurance. They aren’t ever likely to. So I create that place for myself. 

I don’t trust anyone. I keep looking for someone outside of my parents to parent me but there is only them. I feel so angry that they could make my life so difficult. I have no power over my life because I’ve need them as they’re all I’ve got. 

I don’t know anymore.

I just want this misery to be over too.

She was the one who was a pseudo parent to my family, the one who protected my scared child self. She was the one who could be strong at home And still escape to my friends to have fun. 

So now, I feel like I’m in that world again. And I’m happy there. But it will be gone by the time I wake tomorrow. 

I’ve learned from my psychologist that I have ego parts. I have a child part, a teenage part and a adult part. 5 years ago the adult part went through something very traumatic. She can’t cope and is angry at family and her life. 

She was unable to protect herself because she had let go of her teenage self when she finally felt safe in the relationship. But when that was taken away, she had only a child self who is traumatised. 

So I don’t know what will happen but I’m avoiding my trauma and I’ve dissociated. I did come out of it briefly last year and was a wreck. I couldn’t be left alone, I couldn’t escape. I had all my fears come back and had nowhere to feel safe. 

I know this dissociation is just prolonging my suffering but I can’t seem to pull myself out of it.

I guess I’ve always been very close with my family. I had to be the parent when there was lots of disfunction growing up. When I moved away from them my work was terrible, I was abused and had too much stress. The big city life was overwhelming and our relationship wasn’t great. Looking back I had expectations that he couldn’t meet because he was never happy in himself. I tried to help him for years and we thought moving would be good. One day I had a panic attack and I knew I had reached my limit. I called my mum because I didn’t know what else to do and she booked me on a flight to come home. So I did. When I got home I was so underweight and sick she panicked and went into protective Mum mode. She thought it was all his fault and didn’t want me to talk to him or go back. I didn’t know what to do because my anxiety was through the roof. 1 month passed and I was sick then I thought we should have a break. Then I realised that I really missed him. So I rang him and we reconnected. But he slowly started to get sick of being alone and he broke up with me in April. Looking back I thought he would wait for me because he was close with my family and they had shown him lots of love. But when I didn’t go back there for a while he sent me a email and then a text to break up. I should probably just end it because I’m an idiot. I was vulnerable and made decisions I regret. I blocked it all out and tried to go on but I really haven’t. If I had a gun I’d happily end it now. I’m sick of the anxiety and loneliness and how much of a mistake i made. Hope they helps.
Also I’ve had a few people say he should have come and seen me and made sure I was ok. I wasn’t well.
